chosen_titles.rationale: Title I (State Government) houses Ohio's lobbying-disclosure regimes: Ch. 101 Joint Legislative Ethics Committee / legislative-agent registration, Ch. 121 executive-agency lobbyist registration, and Ch. 102 (cross-reference to ethics/financial-disclosure).

notes: OH 2015 vintage present on Justia. Prior 2010 GT and 2025 structure both put all three lobbying regimes (Ch. 101 JLEC, Ch. 121 executive-agency lobbyist, Ch. 102 cross-reference) under Title I State Government; expect identical structure here.
